post.description: Forgets the outages of the day, and enables the snow monkey in the global configuration: from its start time to its stop time, it then injects outages into the routes of its target groups that use the `Snow Monkey Chaos` plugin (`cp:otoroshi.next.plugins.SnowMonkeyChaos`), as their calls come. An audit event (`STARTED_SNOWMONKEY`) and an alert are sent. Only a super admin can call it.

200.description: The snow monkey is enabled and the outages of the day are forgotten: `done` is `true`

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or the global configuration makes the admin api read only (`apiReadOnly`) and the call is not a GET

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin: the admin the backoffice calls on behalf of (`Otoroshi-BackOffice-User`), or the rights the api key carries in its `otoroshi-access-rights` metadata. An api key without such rights is not refused

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

post.description: Forgets the outages of the day, ending the running ones, and disables the snow monkey in the global configuration. An audit event (`STOPPED_SNOWMONKEY`) and an alert are sent. Only a super admin can call it.

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

get.summary: List the running outages of the snow monkey
get.description: Answers the outages the snow monkey is injecting right now, one per route under outage: an outage leaves the list as soon as it ends. Only a super admin can call it.

200.description: The outages running now, one per route under outage

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin: the admin the backoffice calls on behalf of (`Otoroshi-BackOffice-User`), or the rights the api key carries in its `otoroshi-access-rights` metadata. An api key without such rights is not refused

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

delete.summary: Forget the outages of the snow monkey
delete.description: Forgets the outages of the day, ending the running ones: the snow monkey can inject new outages into every route again. An audit event (`RESET_SNOWMONKEY_OUTAGES`) and an alert are sent. Only a super admin can call it.

200.description: The running outages are ended and the outages of the day forgotten: `done` is `true`

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin: the admin the backoffice calls on behalf of (`Otoroshi-BackOffice-User`), or the rights the api key carries in its `otoroshi-access-rights` metadata. An api key without such rights is not refused

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

put.summary: Update the settings of the snow monkey
put.description: Replaces the settings of the snow monkey in the global configuration, and answers them. A missing field takes its default value. An audit event (`UPDATED_SNOWMONKEY_CONFIG`) and an alert are sent. Only a super admin can call it.

requestBody.description: The new settings of the snow monkey

200.description: The settings of the snow monkey, once updated

400.description: The credentials are missing, the body is not json, or it is not the settings of a snow monkey

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or the global configuration makes the admin api read only (`apiReadOnly`) and the call is not a GET

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin: the admin the backoffice calls on behalf of (`Otoroshi-BackOffice-User`), or the rights the api key carries in its `otoroshi-access-rights` metadata. An api key without such rights is not refused

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

patch.summary: Patch the settings of the snow monkey
patch.description: Applies the json patch (RFC 6902) of the body to the settings of the snow monkey, saves them in the global configuration, and answers them. A patch that cannot be applied (an operation on a path that does not exist, a failed `test`) resets every setting of the snow monkey to its default value. An audit event (`PATCH_SNOWMONKEY_CONFIG`) and an alert are sent. Only a super admin can call it.

requestBody.description: The json patch to apply to the settings of the snow monkey

schema.description: The operations to apply to the settings of the snow monkey

200.description: The settings of the snow monkey, once patched

400.description: The credentials are missing, the body is not json, or the patched settings are not the settings of a snow monkey

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or the global configuration makes the admin api read only (`apiReadOnly`) and the call is not a GET

403.description: The admin behind the credentials is not a super admin: the admin the backoffice calls on behalf of (`Otoroshi-BackOffice-User`), or the rights the api key carries in its `otoroshi-access-rights` metadata. An api key without such rights is not refused

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

500.description: The body is not a json patch (answered as a server error)
